title: Chapter 86: The Final Battle Of The Camps (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 86: The Final Battle Of The Camps (Part 2)

Waves of Zerglings rushed up at the critical moment. If ordinary armies faced this situation, their mentality would have collapsed long ago!

But these soldiers of the evil god camp are all fanatics of the evil god. The faith in their hearts prevents them from collapsing at any time!

The cavalry of the evil god camp, which cannot be bypassed, can only continue to fight with the Zerg Zerglings that rushed up, stretching the entire front line even longer.

In this way, the speed of troop consumption of both sides increased again.

In this way, the reinforcements of the evil god camp continued to arrive, and correspondingly, the Zerg Zerg Zerglings also joined the battle in numbers of 3,000 or 5,000 at intervals.

When the cavalry of the evil god camp and the Zerg Zerg Zerglings were left with less than 5,000 troops, they dared not continue to fight with the Zerg Zerglings, and retreated to the side to rest and guard.

They were not afraid, but worried that other troops could not catch up with the speed of the Zerg army, allowing the Zerg army to run away again.

This time their worries were unnecessary. The Zerg army was no longer prepared to continue to mobilize them. The Zerg now had the strength to fight a decisive battle with the army of the evil god camp here.

The enemy and own troops consumed on the battlefield were converted into system resources by the system. The system resources were converted into Zerg troops again through the Zerg base and continued to be put into battle.

Such a cycle is like a snowball, which gets bigger and bigger.

The Zerg is also growing rapidly in this resource conversion cycle of the system.

The army of the evil god camp is getting smaller and smaller. When most of the troops return to the camp to participate in the camp war, the troops that continue to encircle and suppress the Zerg army are scattered. Excluding those that have been consumed, there are only about 70,000 to 80,000.

In order to encircle the Zerg army, these troops are scattered and there is no time to gather and fight a decisive battle with the Zerg army.

The army of the evil god camp seems to have realized the essence of the human wave tactics on its own. Thousands of reinforcements continue to rush to participate in the battle and compete with the Zerg army in consumption.

This is a war of attrition whose outcome has long been determined. With the support of the system, the Zerg is like having a cheat. Such a war of attrition will only make the Zerg stronger and stronger!

The long war of attrition continued. Both sides of the battle were like tools without emotions, fighting and consuming each other mechanically. In addition, there were no corpses left on the battlefield. This war could no longer make people feel tragic.

...

The battlefield of the other camp war was much more tragic and tragic!

The soldiers of the Tengu clan were all normal intelligent beings. Even if they knew they would die, they were ready to face death. When they really faced death, they also broke out with all kinds of strong emotions!

There were warriors who were brave and fearless, and there were also cowards who collapsed in the face of battle and turned to run away!

The power of an individual is too weak on such a battlefield. Whether you are a warrior or a coward, no matter what you choose, the final outcome is death!

The wide battlefield has become a sea of corpses and blood.

The soldiers of both sides continued to step on the corpses of their comrades and wade through the blood to fight desperately.

Once this camp decisive battle started, it was not so easy to stop.

This is not only a battle of winning or losing in the war, but also a battle of luck between the two camps!

The winner wins everything! The loser loses everything! Victory or defeat is crucial!

The battle lasted from noon to the setting sun, and the forces of both sides were sharply reduced. The forces of the Tengu tribe were halved, with less than 300,000 left.

The evil god camp, together with the troops that returned later, still had about 200,000 troops left.

Judging from the consumption of both sides' forces, the combat capability of the evil god camp's army is stronger than that of the Tengu tribe.

If the Zerg had not mobilized the forces of the evil god camp's army and helped to contain and eliminate a group of the evil god camp's troops, the chances of the Tengu tribe winning this battle would have been very low.

This does not count the sacrifice trump card prepared by the evil god camp. If the two thousand human wanderers were not rescued by the Zerg, but were successfully used by the evil god camp to sacrifice to the evil god, then the Tengu tribe would have been defeated at this moment.

…

On the battlefield of the Zerg, a protracted war of attrition is drawing to a close. When the last team of cavalrymen from the Evil God camp fell under the blade of the dog, there was no soldier from the Evil God camp behind the army of the Evil God camp.

This protracted battle forced the Hydralisk, which had been fighting endlessly, to withdraw from the battle and go to the rear to rest and recover. In the following battles, a steady stream of dogs fought against various armies of the Evil God camp.

Nearly 80,000 Evil God armies fell here, and countless Zerg dogs returned to the system here.

The battlefield, which had expanded to an exaggerated degree, was littered with the remains of weapons and equipment left by the Evil God army and various miscellaneous items that could not be distinguished, indicating the tragic degree of the previous war.

After this battle, there were only more than a thousand dogs left on the battlefield. The dogs that came from the Zerg territory later had already gathered outside the battlefield and no longer entered this dilapidated battlefield.

It was a battle of tragic victory in any way, but it was a feat of leapfrogging development for the Zerg.

At this moment, the Zerg has sufficient resources and its combat strength is growing rapidly. It will soon gather a huge Zerg army again.

The Queen has been paying close attention to the situation of the decisive battle between the two camps. Wu Qing knows the changes in the strength of both sides very well. Let them fight for a while, and the Zerg will be able to go on the field.

Wu Qing is not satisfied with the current gains. He wants to lead the Zerg to the front battlefield to fight a big battle.

The Zerg was accumulating troops, and the system's gas resources were unprecedentedly abundant. Wu Qing consumed several rounds of larvae and hatched another two thousand Hydralisks.

Among the three thousand original Hydralisks, the number of one-star Hydralisks increased to 25. Under the leadership of 25 one-star Hydralisks, the five thousand Hydralisks were a terrifying long-range killing force!

After resting and replenishing energy, the three thousand Hydralisks became lively again, and joined with the newly born two thousand Hydralisks, and they were no longer tired.

The number of puppies increased rapidly at a rate of more than five hundred every two minutes. After a while, the number of puppies gathered exceeded 30,000.

At Wu Qing's command, the assembled more than 35,000 Zerg troops rushed to the battlefield of the decisive battle in the front camp.

The rear of the evil god camp has now become the territory of the Zerg, and all the intelligent creatures of the evil god camp have been wiped out.

The supply teams and small groups of evil god troops that came through various supply roads were also besieged by the Zerg.

This was equivalent to cutting off the connection between the evil god camp army and the rear, but the battle in front was in full swing, and they had not yet noticed the changes behind them.

When the Zerg army rushed to the rear of the evil god camp army at a moderate speed, the strength of the Tengu clan and the evil god army had dropped below 200,000.

The troops left now were all elite troops from both sides. By now, both sides were exhausted, and it was almost evening.
